items: Stylish Deep V Bras for Women - This Plunge bra adopts a breathable mesh V neck design that's perfect for summer, preventing sweating and showcasing a seductive cleavage. Each semi-fixed pad has over 200 ventilation holes to keep you cool and comfortable for 24 hours and also to reduce the shifting or flipping of the pads during washing, making it easy to adjust afterward.

Wireless Jelly Bras for Women with Support-Avidlove push up bras feature hugging "W" shape jelly bands and 3D molded cups that gently gather and lift your breasts, creating upright and round chests-no wires needed, delivering the confidence of total security and a perfect, natural shape.

Super Soft and Comfortable Bras-Avidlove womens bras are made from high-quality fabric with a delicate texture, highly breathable and skin-friendly, providing a smooth feeling and as lightweight as a cloud. The high-stretch fabric perfectly conforms to the body shape, effectively preventing the bra from slipping down when raising your arms. The tagless design prevents chafing. So comfortable you'll forget you're even wearing it.

Seamless Bras with Back Smoothing - Seamless full coverage bras are design with adjustable, non-slip shoulder straps, a seamless U-shaped back, and widened side wings to reduce pressure, smoothing out side and back fat for a natural, flowing body curve. The back clasp has 5 rows of 3 hooks (with an extension hook) to ensure a comfortable and snug fit.

T-shirt Bras for Everyday Wear - These comfy everyday bras ensure invisibility under T-shirts, shirts, dresses or sweaters and can be worn as an everyday bra, T-shirt bra, unpadded sleep bra, shaping bra, casual bra, or lightweight sports bra. Ideal for daily comfort, relaxation, and low-impact activities. Please machine wash (in a laundry bag) or hand wash.
